lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-contrast white circular spots arranged in approximate horizontal rows, with the most prominent clusters situated immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical light-toned striations align with the horizontal spot rows, forming a loose grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper dorsal-lateral region, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the left pectoral fin; dense aggregation of small teleost fish visible in the surrounding water column.
